name: hazel_weir_central_procedural_graph
description: Optimized Central Procedural Graph featuring Day 30 Town Shop arbitrage extension, lean tiered workforce scaling, contiguous land expansion to 28-32 plots, maturation-synchronized seed purchasing, and terminal day-30 harvest liquidation.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, crop maturity horizons, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Preemptively matches unlocked town shop demand surges and immediately fulfills mature high-margin crops (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins, Strawberries) across all 30 days to capture 2.0x-3.5x contract price premiums.

nodes.name: Shed Headroom Relief
nodes.description: Prevents silent 100/100 harvest discards by clearing uncommitted inventory under strict price floors while protecting animal feed, town shop contract reserves, and executing terminal day-30 shed sweep.

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast to front-run market gluts, dumping vulnerable commodities at peak prices (>= 1.15x base) before opponent dumping collapses spot prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash beyond lean wage reserves into workforce acceleration (10-hand rush by Day 4), contiguous land expansion (up to 28-32 plots), commercial high-yield seeds synchronized with crop maturation horizons, and fertilizer.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes field routines with strict operational sequencing: harvest ready crops with localized cluster sweeps, worker drop-offs, priority watering, livestock feeding, phase-gated planting, and ground maintenance.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases (BUY_SEED, BUY_ANIMAL, BUY_LAND, redundant HIRE); schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll without overdraft.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals > 0 ? max(4, n_animals * 3) : 0); do not rely on low-margin fertilizer sales to cover payroll deficits; never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (net_available_cash >= 120.0 or shop_deliverable_inventory > 0) and step <= 718
attributes.guidance: Allocate 1-2 market order slots to deliver matching mature shed inventory directly to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premium; procure shop-demanded seeds (Carrots, Tomatoes, Pumpkins) when surplus cash covers seed costs and wage buffers through day 28. On days 29-30, prioritize 100% of deliverable inventory to fulfill active shop orders before general liquidation.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not commit seed capital if net cash falls below 1.20x midnight payroll reserve; do not purchase shop seeds if shed capacity exceeds 85%; never hold shop produce past contract expiration windows; cap shop market orders at 2 per step to preserve worker execution slots under the 10-order cap.

attributes.condition: (shed_used + incoming_worker_inventory >= 80) or (day == 30 and hour >= 20 and shed_used > 0)
attributes.guidance: Evict pending non-urgent buy orders to free order slots; execute batch sales of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings with price >= 0.75 * base_price; relax floor to 0.50 * base_price if shed_used >= 92 to prevent discard drops; on Day 30 (step >= 716), execute full terminal liquidation of all remaining commodities to convert all inventory into final cash.
attributes.pitfalls: Never fire-sell at sub-0.50 base price during transient shed spikes; never liquidate Wheat below livestock feed reserve (n_animals > 0 ? max(4, n_animals * 3) : 0); never evict produce allocated for active town shop fulfillment; do not exhaust more than 2 order slots on sales per step.

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable unreserved commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry, Pumpkin) while current market price remains favorable (> 0.75 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not dump into already collapsed sub-0.50 base price markets unless shed overflow is imminent; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts; limit liquidation to 1-2 orders per step to avoid order starvation for hands.

attributes.condition: (net_available_cash >= (day <= 4 ? midnight_payroll_due * 1.15 + 80.0 : midnight_payroll_due * 1.30 + 160.0)) and (hired_hands < 10 or (uncultivated_plots <= 2 and total_plots < 32 and day <= 24) or (has_seed_deficit and day <= 29) or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 29
attributes.guidance: Aggressively scale workforce to the 10-hand cap by Day 4 using lean tiered reserves; purchase contiguous land plots (scaling up to 28-32 plots) when existing plots are fully utilized (uncultivated_plots <= 2) through Day 24; procure high-margin commercial seeds synchronized with crop maturation horizons: halt Pumpkins after Day 24, Tomatoes after Day 26, and Carrots after Day 28; restrict Day 29 seed procurement strictly to fast-turnaround Wheat; halt all capital purchases on Day 30 to maximize terminal net cash.
attributes.pitfalls: Never allocate reinvestment capital if net cash after purchase drops below dynamic payroll reserve; do not purchase land plots beyond worker watering bandwidth (cap at 32 contiguous plots); do not buy long-cycle seeds that cannot mature before step 716; halt all hiring and land acquisition after Day 24.

attributes.guidance: Dispatch active hands strictly by operational priority: 1) Harvest mature crops using localized adjacent plot sweeps to minimize walking transit before initiating shed drop-offs; 2) Drop off carried inventory when full or when nearest shed transit is optimal; 3) Water dry planted crops to prevent growth stalls; 4) Feed hungry livestock; 5) Plant commercially viable seeds matched to remaining season days; 6) Weed clearing and plot tilling. On Day 30 (step >= 696), halt all tilling and weeding; focus 100% of hand bandwidth on harvesting remaining mature crops and delivering all carried items to the shed before step 716 for final liquidation.
attributes.pitfalls: Never prioritize weeding or tilling over harvesting ripe crops or watering drying plots; do not leave mature crops unharvested across multi-step windows; avoid single-item shed drop-off round trips when adjacent ripe plots can be harvested; ensure all hands deposit carried inventory before step 716 so zero items remain stranded.
